svg.title: The Dapr API calls a resiliency policy can be applied to
svg.desc: A dashed boundary named Your solution holds five applications, each an app hexagon with a Dapr sidecar docked on it. App A sits in the middle: its sidecar gets state from a state store on the left, publishes to a message broker on the right, calls a method on App B below it, and calls an actor on App C. An input binding triggers App A from above. From the broker, two subscribe lines run to App D and App E, and App E invokes an output binding to a system outside the boundary. App B retrieves a secret from a secret store. Seven white callout cards, each with a dashed leader to the call it names, give the resiliency target for every one: state management, publish and subscribe, service invocation, actors, secret management and the two bindings, with the target keys apps, actors, and components outbound or inbound.
